-- Spec: count how many non-blocking sends succeed on a bounded int channel.

accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2, 3]) == 0
  ex accepted(5, []) == 0
  let (tx, rx) = Channel[int](cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    tx.try_send(x) else break
    n += 1
  n
